title: Field Contracts
subtitle: Optional work that supports routes without becoming a faction overhaul
summary: Early field contracts should be small, optional, readable, and useful. They should not block the main Ashfall route.
body: The Crashbreak relay proof contract asks for route confirmation, not combat.
Good contract rewards help the next route: power cells, scrap, scanner supplies, route notes, or reputation notes.
Contract standing and reward text must name the faction posture, the expected hand-in, and the exact support granted before the player accepts the work.
